title: I Expected More & Better at This High Price
text:
I Expected More & Better at This High Price. Cons:
Terrible Remote Control. While they added color to the power button, making it easy to identify, they inexplicably did not add color to the other buttons on the remote. This is a small remote with tiny buttons. They made the symbols virtually the same color as the top of the remote. It's very hard to see which button is which. Sure, you'll memorize it eventually, but it shouldn't be this way on a very expensive small heater.

There is no thermostat. This is a shocking omission on a heater retailing for $159. You have to manually turn it off when you get hot. Then manually turn it back on when you get cold. So, forget about using it in a bedroom all night while you sleep, since the heat will output constantly instead of shutting off when it hits your desired room temperature.

$159 retail price is way, way, way too high. The $159 value just isn't there for this heater. Even at a discounted $109 price, the value just isn't there because of the lack of an automatic thermostat.

Pros:
It does put out heat very fast.
Its ability to oscillate both up & down and left & right.
Its compact size with carry handle at the top makes it very easy to carry and place in different locations.
It includes fan-only (with no heat) as an option, if desired.
Benefits of it having PTC Graphene Material
